info.title: Tabsera Academy API
info.description: REST API for Tabsera Academy — an e-learning platform with courses, tutoring sessions, AI tutors, payments (WaafiPay), and certificates. Production base URL: https://academy.tabsera.com (all endpoints prefixed with /api)

servers.description: Production (Caddy reverse proxy, all API paths prefixed with /api)
